ordered_classification_branches: 2 exact (line,col) inside a COMMENT token -> historical text (non-behavioral)
3 inside a module/class/function docstring span -> historical text (non-behavioral)
4 position equals an ast.Attribute's own start, derived as end_col_offset - len(attr) because an Attribute shares col_offset with its base -> attribute reference
5 equals an ast.keyword position -> keyword reference
6 equals an ast.arg position -> argument definition
7 equals an ast.Name in Store context -> assignment target
8 equals a ClassDef/FunctionDef name position (node col_offset + len of the keyword) -> definition site
9 equals an ast.alias position -> import binding
10 inside a Constant whose value EQUALS the term -> string key constant (behavioral)
11 inside any other Constant -> prose string (classified by its caller, never assumed harmless)
12 equals an ast.Name in Load context -> bare name (identifier coincidence)
13 otherwise -> unattributed; this bucket must be 0
